A '''Nightsister melee armguard''' were an item of biceps [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn by some [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was made of metal and covered with carvings.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> [[Axkva Min]], a [[Witch/Legends|witch]] who was imprisoned in the [[Chamber of Banishment]], was known to own one such armguard.<ref name="SWG:AM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=heroic|Axkva Min}}</ref>
